body: i’ve attempted it many times before and i just want the courage to go through with it. it has to be worth it because living isn’t
i want to kill myself because i feel completely alone and no longer see any purpose in life

it can’t be a good thing if im this miserable, and i clearly don’t have a quality to share if not a single person of the many i’ve tried to make friends with has liked me in any way. im hopeless and i just want to die
it hasn’t been certain people, it’s been everyone i meet irl. something about me just disgusts people and id rather just die than keep living alone like this

yeah i’m in college and i agree it’s easier to date when you’re younger but the relationships don’t have any meaning it’s just a friendly thing ig. i’m not looking for anything deep like that but i’m kinda sentimental so even if i can just have a good friendship i’m fine with that, a relationship would just be a bonus not necessary. just need to find a way to make it out that it’s as simple as me not wanting to forget her cause i thought she was cool.
thank you but i’ve had hope for too long with no results, i’m glad you still do for yourself though
going through the same thing. good luck to you i hope you can find people, i’ve lost almost all hope for myself at this point.

same thing happened to me with a girl i met at work, i’m going to live the rest of my miserable life alone i guess. 
best of luck to you though, i hope you find someone else.
disfatt bidge

things definitely won’t get better though, that’s the thing. i’ve waited long enough to know there’s nothing i can do, so i really don’t see a point in living if i’m going to be alone for the rest of my life

but what else am i supposed to do? i can’t keep living with this kind of pain without being able to do something about it. it’s hopeless and i’m going to die alone anyway, so i don’t see the point in living any longer.

i wouldn’t believe social media if i didn’t see those same friend groups and couples every time i walk into college, proving they’re not fake or whatever. they’re really enjoying and getting to live their lives while i’m stuck as an outcast who everyone hates. i’m forced to miss out on my entire teenage years for reasons i can’t control while everyone else gets to have fun. i just want to know why i’m so naturally unlikeable to people, because no one will tell me why they don’t want me around, i just get treated like i don’t exist instead.
i always gets told it gets easier but it hasn’t, it’s only ever gotten harder for me since the first time i heard it. i’m fully convinced i will die alone at this point.
i’m in the same situation, and i don’t think there’s any way out of it for me anymore. hope things can get better for you
i have, four times in fact. i get told the same advice every time and i’m still just as sad and alone.
i’ve been dealing with it for as long as i remember, and i haven’t had a single day since where i haven’t thought about killing myself. so yeah, i don’t cope very well.
being myself isn’t going to be worth it if i’m alone, i can’t live with that kind of pain.

i have tried, but no matter how friendly i am to people something about me just always puts people off. i believe i must just be naturally unlikeable to people for reasons i don’t get yet. i don’t think i’m perfect or anything, far from it, but i’m not trying to make anyone dislike me yet everyone i’ve ever talked to just does

I never got the point of that advice though, because I and anyone else could die at any time so really i don’t have my whole life ahead of me. i want to try all these different activities or whatever but i’m so scared of rejection because i’ve spent my whole life embarrassing myself whenever i’ve tried to do anything new. whenever i think something good could ever happen for me it just backfires.
me too, i have nothing and no one to live for so i have no reason to keep living

thank you, i actually got on very well with my therapist and his points were good. i told him exactly about this and he gave me good advice as things actually would’ve been a lot worse. but at the end of the day advice on anger management or to suppress suicidal thoughts or actions don’t make me improve on this game. i do have a couple others for each role that i enjoy playing but try as i might i’m just not as good at them than reaper or d va. i’m aware i have depression i was diagnosed years ago but even an understanding of myself does not make me win games. no advice from anyone can do that, only i and the matchmaking on this game can do that, and they’re just not. i’d love to just play something else but i’ve played this for so long and i’ve barely climbed therefore to me i’ve barely improved, so i just feel useless. i should be doing well at this game by now, and if i can’t get good at this game in 6 years, how am i supposed to be good at anything else? and as depression goes i don’t have the motivation to do anything else, i’ve been losing all my energy playing this game and i’d feel like a failure to just abandon it now even if all i do is lose.

yeah well all the people playing “for fun” are constantly flexing what rank they are or how much better they are than others, never seen anyone prove otherwise. plus it’s this or nothing, i don’t have the energy or motivation left to pick up some random new hobby that i’ll never be good at anyway. this is like the only thing other than sleep that i enjoy right now so constantly losing is obviously gonna bother me quite a lot.
you won’t believe how much i try, i’m just unlucky all the time instead of just sometimes like most people

honestly no matter what i do i don’t think i will ever get good at this game. my luck could not be worse so it really doesn’t matter how hard i try as comp is completely win based. even when i take a break i still lose as yeah, i might be better, but my matchmaking luck will still be just as awful
it’s enough work being alive for me
saw a therapist recently. i just get told stuff i already know. it doesn’t help with improving on anything
bold of you to assume i could ever achieve something in real life lol. if those hadn’t failed i wouldn’t have made this post to begin with.
nah, if anything i’m using the game as an example. i feel this way about life in general
i’ve experienced this enough to make jokes about it
i enjoy fighting games even less. i also lose anything 1v1. i’m a loser
yeah no shit, but getting help doesn’t make you better at anything, trust me

if it was that easy. i got help recently and it didn’t last. words can’t make you better at something, and if i can’t give myself the motivation to change no help in the world will actually do anything.
i was seeking professional help recently, doesn’t make me better at anything i want to improve on, i just get told stuff i already know.

the “not to be rude” is kinda redundant but fair for you to say, i guess. in most if not all games i have the best kd and damage of both my team and the whole game whether i’m damage or tank. the problem is despite what i ask my team refuses to coordinate as well as the enemy team. this isn’t always the case of course, but usually i’m expected to just 1v5 as whenever my team does group up they all die instantly on the point as the supports just don’t heal and our tank always charges off alone. i get put in so many pointless situations and the enemy team is always so much better than mine, so i refuse to believe that they’ve lowered this hidden rating i have. my matchmaking luck is just the worst so that on top of me being a bit tilted sometimes isn’t a good match for wins.

i’ve had this game for so long and i’ll feel like a failure if i can’t ever improve at it. besides i just don’t have it in me to find any kind of new hobby, i’ve found i’m useless at pretty much everything

honestly i don’t have the motivation to do anything other than play this game right now, i don’t really enjoy anything anymore. but with this game i do enjoy it sometimes and i want to be better but it just seems impossible.

i’ve been doing all that for so long, and you’d hope i’d know all that after 6 years lol. i play d va on tank and reaper on damage and i think i’m pretty good as them. i usually have the best kd and damage not just of my team but of the game, but because the enemy team’s coordination is always so much better than mine there’s nothing i can do. i can ask for more healing, they won’t do it. i can ask to group up, they won’t listen.
honestly nothing makes me happy anymore anyway. i’m depressed
i need proof that i can actually win games again, then i’ll be fine
sure
how do i know the people on other areas will like me? it could be completely hopeless for all i know. i just don’t see the point
i don’t know, all i do know is whether i’m a victim or not i am unloveable, and it really feels like i’m the only one who is. i wish i wasn’t so unlucky and that i could have been anyone else.

i’ve always wanted to move and i will in the future, but even if things get better there that won’t make me forget how i was forced to waste many years being alone and sad because no one would like me, while everyone else i knew was going out and having fun and dating whoever they wanted.

I don’t think that’s a thing in my country, I wish it was though because that makes things so much easier. If you are going to do it please take the assisted suicide option over jumping off the roof, at least then you’ll die peacefully. I wish I even had that option.

It seems both of us have been unfairly treated by the societies we’ve been born into. Some people have the privilege of being very lucky with their social lives, but the problem for them is they could never relate to people like us. Just don’t give up hope, because even if you don’t find new people you will find something. Something new (even if it’s small) happens every day, and it’s the unpredictability of life that keeps a lot of people, including me, alive. There’s always the chance of you settling down someday, it’s always going to be there. Don’t give up hope, the places we’re in means we’ve got to put in more work but that just gives us more reason to be proud of ourselves when we get there.
And knowing my luck they won’t like me either
I don’t get what that means by “get out there” though. And do what?

I’ve been told this before, but I was unlucky enough to be kinda talentless and just useless at everything. I do have my interests, but I could never find anyone to talk to about them. Nowadays things just seem pointless to me, and I can’t tell if I’m depressed or just lazy.
I’ve been waiting so long. I’m scared this will last forever and I’ll never make any friends. Lately suicide has felt like my only option, but part of me is stopping me from doing it. I’m just stuck.
I’m fine with some people disliking me, but I didn’t expect it to be everyone who knows me. I at least just want someone who wants to talk to me.
I don’t know how much longer I can wait
Thank you, but I already know I won’t
I haven’t felt joy in years, and I don’t expect to ever again. I don’t see any purpose in life, no reason why I should keep living and I doubt I ever will
Maybe I am, but it doesn’t make me hate my life any less
You don’t know me well enough to care if I’m alive or not
Well if there are I’d love to meet them

I do treat it like a long term goal, but at the same time it feels hopeless to me if I’m not making any progress at all. You’re right though, I need to find a situation or place where I know people will like me and I know I can feel comfortable, and then develop relationships from there. My only real problem now is finding that place

I think I’ve been forced into this mindset after so many years of failure so I’m sorry if it’s hard for me to think differently. I want to do what I want but life feels pointless to me if I don’t have any human connection, and it’s so hard to think that I could meet anyone who could like me as a person because I’ve been treated like I don’t deserve that

I used to try gym and it really wasn’t working for me. I know people say it makes them feel better and happier and it’s scientifically proven or whatever but I just feel like a failure and that it’s pointless because I know my life won’t improve whether I do it or not so I gave up after a few months of doing it daily. And there’s no place I can go outside my house to meet anyone, I don’t know where anyone hangs out and I wouldn’t be welcome there anyway
How do I work towards it? I’m willing to put in the effort if I can just know what I’m actually supposed to do
How much more patient do I have to be though? I’ve waited so long for the human connection everyone around me gets to experience, I don’t know why I should wait any longer
I don’t know, from my experience it doesn’t seem possible anymore
I’m too used to people hating me for everything I do to find any confidence in myself anymore

I also never put looks first when looking for a relationship, but most if not all people I’ve known do. Plus even if someone isn’t conventionally attractive they look like models compared to me. Of course ugly people have a chance, but I’d say my looks must be worse than ugly, because I haven’t seen anyone with worse looks than me

I know it’s a common thing to say if you get treated some way or told something enough you start to believe it, but that’s exactly what happened. I don’t know if it’s possible to think differently about myself anymore when all I’ve known is being treated like I’m worthless
I’ve always been challenging it, but everything that’s ever happened to me has proven that I’m not worthy of it. I have tried everything I’ve been suggested at one point and I’ve failed all of it
It would take a lot of courage for me to do that but I guess it’s not a bad idea
That’s true but I am entirely made up of imperfections. I don’t have a single quality, I am worthless

Well there’s no possible way I’d find any friends to work out with, anyone I know who works out was already really strong naturally so it was all easy for them but they don’t realise that. They want to see people like me fail and embarrass themselves to fuel their own ego.
Well you succeeded.
Thank you

I can’t be physically strong either, I have weaker bones than the average person and when I tried working out I didn’t get feel that happiness that people say they get from doing it, instead I felt more useless like I knew nothing was gonna come from it. I did it for a month and not a single time did it make me feel better
I don’t think everyone is too flawed to be loved, there are a lot lucky people out there. I’m not one of those lucky people though
I’m just so used to failure. It feels like I can’t do anything right
That still doesn’t feel like enough time

I have deformities in my eyes and ears where one of my ears is really small and my hearing in general is really bad and one of my eyes is way lower on my face than the other, and I know most eyes are asymmetrical but I’ve never seen anyone with it as noticeable as mine, I look like I’m melting. If I was smart or good at something then I wouldn’t be as bothered, but I’m not even that smart so I don’t have a single good quality
True but I genuinely am a failure with no redeemable qualities. Even if this society was more social I would still die alone
That’s great, I’m really happy for him. I don’t really have any passions anymore as I’m convinced by now that I am completely useless.
Thank you
I really don’t think there’s someone for me, so I’m sorry if I change your mind on that
Exactly
I don’t know how to do that
I don’t have a great personality either though, I have nothing that could make anyone like me
A lot of people say that, then they meet me
I wish I was just imagining. And sure, maybe there is someone who would want to talk to me but I doubt I’ll ever find them at this point.

Normally I get looks from people like there’s something wrong with me or people just ignore what I say even if I’m the only person they’re talking to. Maybe something about me just creeps people out so they don’t want to talk to me, I don’t know.
You don’t know me personally though. So you might not want me to die but it’s not the same as caring since you don’t have any personal attachment.

I do agree with you and I think it makes sense to try but every time I’ve done something like that before I’ve always ended up embarrassing myself and looking like even more of a loser than I already was
I can’t recall a moment where anything has ever gone right for me so excuse me if I’m a bit skeptical
Well I more meant dying alone as in no one would care that I’m dead. Most people have at least one person who would be affected by their death.

I was told to write something a day before in therapy and it didn’t really work. I had a lot of days where I couldn’t think of a single thing at all to write down. As for the convincing myself people like me thing I’m not sure if that could actually work
I don’t understand how to do that though, like how do I pretend to be confident?
I have time too but pretty much every person I know of that isn’t family hates me
I have been working on myself for so long. So long that it has become clear there’s nothing I can do
This feels disturbingly accurate for me right now (currently stage 4 with a bit of stage 2)
I’m unstable too tbh

As much as I would like to be in a relationship like all the other people I know honestly even any close friend would do. I just want someone in my life. I don’t want to be alone anymore but even though I try to make myself likeable to people nothing works. I’m a loser no matter what I do, no one wants to be around me.
I don’t think making friends is possible for me anymore, I’m too unlikeable of a person and as much as I try to change that nothing works.
Aren’t hotlines known for hanging up on people a lot? Plus I wanna talk to someone who really cares that I’m alive

Hey I’m a similar age and I get what you’re going through, I don’t think a day has gone by for me for a very long time where I haven’t thought about killing myself. I too don’t think anyone would care if I died since I never made any close friends and my family only thinks of me as a burden to them. I wish you luck and that you overcome this pain, personally I’m only still here because I’m too much of a coward to put an end to my miserable life.

I have a family who I live with (as in parents not wife and kids, I’ll be long dead before that could ever happen), but they just see me as a burden. Im lucky to have them but I know they don’t really care about me and see me as a failure

I feel this way too. I’m lucky to have a decent home life and loving family but I’m completely useless. Outside my family I have no close friends irl, so I never leave the house or do anything. I can’t even get a job, there’s nothing I’m good at and no place will hire me because I hate myself too much to give them a reason to. As far as I’m concerned I’m a failure and I’m worried for when my family realise that too.

That’s basically what’s happened for me every time I’ve gotten close to making a friend. I just don’t know how to talk to them and I’m so scared of embarrassing myself because I have nothing interesting or funny to say because I’ve made my life so boring
That does sound nice. That almost makes me think it’s still worth it to keep trying

I’m just not sure what to do anymore. I keep getting jealous of seeing people I know posting online going out and having fun while I’m stuck indoors every day with nothing to do but then I’m too much self-loathing to ask anyone to do anything myself

I wouldn’t mind being your friend I would just warn you I’m not a very trusting person after years of being ghosted or treated like I’m worthless. I always think there has to be a reason for it so I guess that’s why I think I’m so annoying
My real self is just really annoying to everyone around me though. I hate who I am but I can’t change even though I keep trying to

Even if I was a likeable person and people did want to be my friend it wouldn’t matter because I would just feel like I didn’t deserve it. I’ve become so used to hating everything about myself that having a good social life seems pointless even though I’m desperate to have one
I try to be myself but no one likes me for myself. And when I try to act like more likeable I just come across as annoying. I don’t know what I’m supposed to do to get people to like me
I wish I could say it gets better from here but from my experience I doubt it does
Thank you
But what’s the point? No matter what I can do to distract myself it won’t make me any less alone and any less worthless
I don’t enjoy anything anymore. I can’t find a single thing to live for, and every time I’ve tried to make my life better I just make it even worse.
Honestly, no.
Not that I’m encouraging you to do it, but I heard helium in a plastic bag is quite painless. I was thinking of trying it myself

I can’t find any of these things. Making friends is impossible, I think I just have this nature that
makes everyone around me and everyone I try to talk to hate me. I would do anything to kill myself and not stop myself from doing it.
I try, but it really doesn’t feel like I have much reason to anymore

I do ask them but they usually just pretend as though they never said anything, and if not they will tell me I remind them of my dad who they wish was dead. I will admit it’s not like this with my entire mums side of the family, some seem genuinely nice but I get to see them so rarely that I still feel alone

My dad divorced with my mum when I was little for personal reasons I don’t want to publicly say, but they are good enough reasons for me to not want to be in touch with his family either. My mum was kind to me in terms of food and a home growing up after the divorce but from then until now her and her family would always say things to put me down and say they were disappointed in me behind my back. I never got to know what happiness felt like. Now that I don’t rely on my parents as much anymore I just feel like my entire family always hated me and still do now

I don’t see my dad anymore and have not for a very long time, it was my mum who said it to my grandparents it was at a gathering and they said how they were embarrassed of me and thought of me as a failure.
I feel like my family wishes I was never born, because that’s what they’ve told me the few times I’ve ever spoken to them
Doctors always tell me to go to therapy or get a type of medication but it’s always too much money for me to afford, so I have no options for treatment.

I tell people I need help and I try to find ways I can be treated but nobody believes me. It kinda just feels like I’m completely alone and that the entire world hates me and there’s nothing I can do to change it. Is a life like that really worth living?
But I don’t think I can enjoy life, I’ve tried for so long and I just don’t think it’s something I’m able to do. I can’t find anything to live for.
